checklist.text: It builds (dotnet build: no errors, no warnings)
Smoke test (qa-plan.md section 3); the floor still draws (hologram.fs changed: if it is black or the game crashes at start, check streamDistance and the streamPts[9] array)
Esc menu, New world: a creek runs from a spring into the pool, 0.9 wide to 2.4, with a lip at the bank; the painted water edge matches where birds stop
Glints run downstream; the creek widens a little while the ground is soaked after rain (Tab, make it rain) and narrows as it dries
Nothing floats or sinks near the water: birds wading, seed over the pool landing on the surface and plipping, splashes, feathers; clicks and pouring over the creek land under the cursor
Birds sip and bathe along the creek; bathers do not vanish in the deeper middle
Birds cross the creek: a low slow hop over narrow water, a flight over wide; they land clear of water and rocks and never cross the pool; nobody gets stuck against a bank
Save and reload keeps the same creek; an old save has none
Tuning if it looks small or odd: SpringRadius, MouthRadius, StreamLength* and MaxSwell (Pool.cs), StreamSlack (Terrain.cs)

description: World Beautification D (pool dip) and E1-E2 (session 50). Terrain.SurfaceAt gives a flat water level over a sunken bed; the creek lives in Pool.cs (DistanceAt covers pool and creek) and hologram.fs (streamDistance). BirdMover.Crossing.cs lets birds hop or fly over it. Not run: only compiled. E3 (seed drift, sound, minimap, spring look) and F (reeds, lily pads, stones) are still to come.
